asked.item: Does an Instagram post show on Facebook Page automatically?
Will picking Facebook too cause people to see it twice?

verdict.reason: The Instagram auto-share sentences state Blotato's Instagram publisher submits only to Instagram and explain the duplicate check when native crossposting is enabled.

steps.text: Do not assume an Instagram-only post also published to Facebook.
Blotato's Instagram publisher submits to Instagram, and Instagram's native sharing behavior is separate from Blotato's destination results.
If you want both destinations, connect Instagram and the intended Facebook Page, then select both in Blotato and verify each result.
If Instagram's native crossposting is enabled, check Facebook before sending an additional Facebook post to avoid duplicates.
